description: This file contains the implementation of a testing adapter for Zend_Http_Client, used to simulate HTTP responses for testing purposes without making actual network requests.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Test
classes.description: A mock adapter class implementing Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Interface to simulate HTTP requests and responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Empty constructor; configuration is set via setConfig().

methods.name: setNextRequestWillFail
methods.description: Sets a flag to make the next request fail with an exception.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the adapter, accepting either an array or Zend_Config object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Simulates connecting to a remote server; can throw an exception if the fail flag is set.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Builds and returns an HTTP request string based on provided method, URI, headers, and body.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the next response in the response buffer.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Dummy method to close connection, does nothing.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response(s) to be returned by the read() method.

methods.name: addResponse
methods.description: Adds additional response(s) to the response buffer.

methods.name: setResponseIndex
methods.description: Sets the current position in the response buffer.
